openPoints: CRITICAL — packages/mcp-server/src/transport.ts registers only eapInitiate/Propose/Promote/Contest/Recall, and no file outside packages/mcp-server/src/eap/ imports capability-gateway.ts, recall-worker.ts, promotion-service.ts, contestation-service.ts or persistent-delta.ts: if the governed domain services are reachable only from tests, what exactly is the durability rework protecting in production, and which of the two parallel recall implementations does an operator believe they are calling?

CRITICAL — eapRecall (packages/mcp-server/src/tools/eap.ts:544) writes a `recalls` row with status 'completed' and affectedClaimIds equal to the contested claim ids verbatim, computing no reverse-dependency closure, no checkpoint, no degradation and no scar, while SqliteRecallRepository stores cases in the disjoint tables recall_cases / recall_checkpoints / recall_scars: on what basis can the REWORK-LOG claim the adapters and the services now read 'the SAME rows', and what happens to a tenant that trusts a 'completed' recall that invalidated nothing?

HIGH — validateOperatorApproval (packages/graph-core/src/eap/capabilities.ts:121) compares the stored basedOnSeq against request.currentSeq, a value the caller supplies, and line 110 evaluates `now > Date.parse(expiresAt)` which is false for any unparseable expires_at TEXT value: if scope and the consumed flag are now read from the operator's grant but freshness is still asserted by the requester and expiry fails open on a malformed timestamp, in what sense is the stored approval the only authority?

HIGH — admitPersistentDelta (packages/mcp-server/src/eap/persistent-delta.ts:118) deep-copies state.graphs and state.claimsCache with structuredClone on every call, and incrementalGate (packages/mcp-server/src/gates.ts:165) still spreads the whole roundtrip index per candidate before roundtripScoped rescans it: how does a per-admission full-heap clone plus an O(candidates x claims) spread deliver the asymptotic win the rework claims for a 100k-claim tenant, and what does that cost the event loop under a concurrent admission burst?

MEDIUM — eapInitiate is the one adapter that never enters serialTransaction and HorizonStore.create does read-then-INSERT-OR-REPLACE inside a DEFERRED transaction, while persistent-delta.ts:176 still computes `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq),0)` for cs_deltas in a DEFERRED unit: if a second host process or a second Bun worker ever attaches to the same STATE_DIR, what stops a duplicate initiate from resetting an existing horizon's seq and budget to zero and defeating STALE_BASE?

MEDIUM — PromotionService.getEvents(), getProposalsForParent() and SqliteCapabilityAuditRepository.list() materialize and JSON.parse an entire tenant table with no pagination, promotion_events carries no retention policy at all, and none of the five adapters call appendEvent for KnowledgeContested / PromotionProposed / RecallProgressed / TruthOwnershipSuspended: if the unbounded collection merely moved from the heap to disk and the read path still loads all of it, and no subscriber ever observes these events, which part of defect class 2 and of the event contract in 003 §Events is actually closed?
architectureTip: Make the transport a thin port over the governed aggregates rather than a second implementation of them: one hexagonal boundary where cognitive.* adapters delegate to PromotionService, ContestationService and the RecallWorker saga, so the durability, authorization and closure semantics that already exist cannot be bypassed by the only surface clients can reach.
